title: Mankind’s Dishonor of the Lord of Heavens Brings Catastrophes
body:
As-salaamu `alaykum. Allah, Allah, Allah. I think today is the second of Dhul-Hijjah, but people are saying it
is the first day. Allah Almighty knows. We are happy and we are so pleased to reach another holy month,
another pilgrimage to Hijaz, the Hajj! That is an honor for us, to reach it once again. Therefore, we are saying,
(Mawlana Shaykh stands) Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, laa ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa
lillahi 'l-hamd! Allahuma salli `alaa Sayyidina Muhammad wa `ala aali Sayyidi ‘l-Awwaleen wa ‘l-Akhireen,
habeeb ‘l-Rabbi ’l-`Alameen, wa `ala ashaabihi ‘l-kiraam `ajma’een. Madad yaa RijaalAllah, salaamullah
`alaa RijaalAllah, madad yaa Saahib az-Zaman, Imam al-Mahdi (a)! (Mawlana Shaykh sits) Allah, Allah.
O Our Attenders! As-salaamu `alaykum. A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani
'r-Raheem. Madad yaa RijaalAllah, madad yaa Saahib al-Imdaad. We are reaching the Last Day and the
world is running to its final destination, having run from the time of Adam (a) up to today, passing 7,000
years. Now the dunya is running quickly towards its last station. SubhaanAllah! We are the last nation of
the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) After him no other
prophet or nation will come. We have now reached the last part of Mankind’s life in this world, as it is
mentioned the limit of Mankind will be 7,000 years. SubhaanAllah 'l-`Aliyyu 'l-`Azheem, all Majesty and
Glory is for our Lord, our Creator, Allah!

O People! We are created, as no one creates himself. If I say this instrument just came into existence by itself
no one will accept that, but it has been arranged and organized to be an instrument, not that it can do
something that its Maker can’t; i.e., we can’t reach with our powers from east to west, but this instrument
does. This is from the Signs of the Last Day, the Day of Resurrection.

SubhaanAllah! Absolute Glory is for Allah Almighty for giving us authority to make suhbah so we may see
and listen to what it sees and reach what it reaches! Allah Almighty (swt) has Absolute Majesty, and Absolute
Power Oceans are for Him Almighty! He may do everything Himself, but He is giving us authority up to now.
(An example is) Man is making such incredible instruments that do something we can't do by ourselves. We
may give authority to that machine (camera); it may see and speak what we have been prohibited from seeing
and reaching. SubhaanAllah 'l-`Aliyyu 'l-`Azheem! We are living the last part of Mankind’s time on this
Earth, when Allah Almighty is giving authority or power to Mankind so they may listen and learn something
that informs them more than 4,000 years ago about what is going to happen.
These instruments are given such functions, but we are not reaching that point. However, Allah Almighty
created and granted us someone from among Mankind whose creation was different than that of common
people. He Who created Man also distinguished some of His servants to know something without using such
instruments, and He granted them power and authority to speak in the coming Last Days. Ordinary people
can't know of, speak about or do the incredible things that only some have been granted.
They are saying, "O People! We are approaching the Last Day and what we are doing on the planet is going to
finish.” Don't think that such incredible instruments are giving more power to you, no! Such distinguished
servants of the Lord of Heavens say that the Last Day is approaching. Particularly, the Seal of Prophets (s)
informed his nation what will happen when we approach the Last Day of this dunya: it will be like a book,
opening and closing.
What is going to happen? The Holy Prophet, the most glorified prophet in the Divine Presence, Sayyidina
Muhammad (s), (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) told his nation that when the Last Day approaches there
will be some signs. Now we are in it, seeing those signs, but most people are not asking, "Who brought us to
this planet? How we can be on it?” They say, “We are creatures who just happen to be on this planet.” The
Most Distinguished Prophet (s) in the Divine Presence informed us of the coming signs, and all the prophets

were sent to inform their people of what was going to happen.
Now everything is in the deepest levels of corruption. People are asking about black holes, looking at them in
the skies saying, "We discovered black holes." They look in the skies, but why aren't they looking on Earth for
black holes that swallow people’s personalities? Now there are countless black holes, perhaps for each person
there is one, and if people don’t take care they will fall into them. Also, there are black holes in nighttime and
blue holes in daytime that cover the whole world! But people are drunk and useless, running after their dirty
desires, not taking care to avoid falling into those holes that make them drunk. That is the reason for all the
troubles happening on this planet! The Seal of Prophets (s) said in the Last Days people will run after every
dirty thing and will leave everything that gives them honor here and Hereafter, and will run after black holes
that belong to Shaytan.
Everywhere they are seeing earthquakes. Why? They are not asking from where it is coming or why it is
happening, claiming it is from nature, that under the Earth something is moving. Now, after so many years
that people are living on Earth, what is happening? People's minds are only reaching something that belongs
to nature, but beyond nature, Who is making the shaking of the Earth in different directions and how it is
going to be? They are not asking, and now people are heedless; more than heedless, they are beyond drunk as
they have no belief!
No-belief people never believe in anything, and from that unbelief signs come to them: earthquakes! How is
this big Earth going to be shaken by someone, and, “Who is that Someone?” they are not asking. They claim,
"Our buildings are not so good for an earthquake. We must destroy our homes and build another kind,” but
they are not asking Who is making this after thousands of years! What shaytani people, and they are giving
countless reasons, saying, “We must redesign our buildings and construct them again.” You can try every type
(of prevention), but if the Lord orders it, all of them can be destroyed in seconds! They say in 25 seconds a big
city can come down, but they are not saying Someone Whose Endless Power can make this, and they are not
giving high respect and honor for their Lord, never thinking of their Creator! They only put forth this and that
reason. The main reason is that they are not giving respect to their Creator, and He is going to destroy them!
There are sometimes tsunamis, sometimes cyclones or hurricanes. What is happening? They are not asking,
but they are saying it is from nature. Who is commanding nature? Hurricanes and earthquakes do not occur

by themselves, but there is Someone (in control of them). People say, "Nature, nature, nature," but not, "The
Lord of Creation." Now the Last Days of dunya are finishing. May Allah forgive us from our dirty egos, and
not leave us to follow Shaytan. Now people are following Shaytan and he is carrying them to the worst station.
O People! Say, “Astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah.” O our Lord! Keep us from the bad steps of
shaytanic works and send us some of Your clean servants to save us from bad people, from shaytans, so that
we may be happy here and Hereafter.
If you speak on this topic until next week, it will not finish, but there are some Signs that these are the Last
Days for Mankind.
O People! Come, listen, believe and run away from Shaytan! Run to the Lord's good servants! By following
good ones, you will be saved here and Hereafter and if not, they will follow Shaytan and he will bring them to
black holes.
O People! Come to your Lord's heavenly orders and you will be saved! If you leave that, every time cursing
will come on Earth. I am asking for Allah's forgiveness, Allah (swt) (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits).
Fatihah.
